"He said three Seals need to reach the central gate, he didn’t say all three had to belong to the same group."
"Exactly, even if three different groups each have one Seal, the path to the center will still open." Rindo immediately nodded.
"Then why fight for the Seals at all?" Ethan asked.
"Because they give points?
And points are still one of the most important things for deciding student rankings, the higher the rank, the better." Kain looked at him.

"Besides that, we can’t be lazy and create a bad image of ourselves, if the others get a bad impression of us, other factions might gain more control over the academy, you guys can stay out of it if you want, but the Student Council cannot just sit around." Rindo answered seriously.
Lian did not need to ask which faction he meant and could understand the Student Council President’s logic.
Rodrick wanted to rule the academy, it was not clear why, because naturally there were no direct benefits from it, maybe it was ambition or some other reason.
And he was definitely trying to get the highest rank in this test and create an absolute image of himself in the minds of the other students.

But Young Vorhelm was not stupid enough to stay silent and wait for the day that bastard came after him, doing such a thing would be stupid, especially when he was sure that sooner or later they would face each other.

He did not have an ambition like ruling the academy, but he was not going to let someone like Rodrick rule the academy either, and besides, isolating Kain just because he was Lian’s friend was not going to go unanswered.
This old grudge had to end as soon as possible, so he could focus on more important goals, such as clearing the Ruined Realm and finding the Calamity Anchor that had spread across their world.
And at that moment, the Silvercrest Gryphon flying above them suddenly changed its direction.
Liana remained still for a few seconds and her eyes focused on a distant point, she was using her summon’s vision.
"There is a large group northwest of us moving, very large...my God, I think group is not the right word, this looks more like an army."
"How many people?" Rindo asked with a frown.
"At least seventy...no, more are arriving."
"At least seventy?
There is only one person who can bring this many students with him." Kain muttered.
Everyone looked in the same direction.
From a distance of several kilometers, the figures could only be seen as small dots, but their number was clearly increasing.
Students from two other bridges were also moving toward the same point.
There was no need to see Rodrick’s face, and the fact that people were gathering at one point with such speed almost made the answer clear.
"The First Stage forced him to be alone, but the Second Stage is giving him back his biggest advantage." Rindo’s face became more serious.
But a few seconds later, the large group changed and almost divided into three sections, each section moving toward a different pillar of light.
Kain was silent for a moment.
"Well...it seems some people don’t need to make decisions like we do." Seraphina pointed out an obvious fact.
"That is exactly the problem." The Student Council President did not take his eyes off the group, he felt like he had lost his position.
If Rodrick kept all his people together, he could have made a big mistake.
But he had not, he had sent three groups toward three Seals.
If all three succeeded, his faction could open the central path by itself.
And even if he did not take the Crown himself, controlling three Royal Seals would create a huge political and point advantage in the test.

Besides, losing to Rodrick’s group, especially when the Student Council President, his Vice President and the most likely next successor were all in one group, would destroy all the prestige and status they had left.
Now all their thoughts and plans were messed up, they did not want to let this bastard create an unbeatable and legendary image of himself in the minds of the other students.
But now how were they supposed to stop something like this?
He was making a move that they could not make with their limited numbers.
"Lian, you don’t have an idea what we should d--where did he suddenly go!" Kain’s eyes fell on his friend, hoping that he had a plan.
But Lian was nowhere to be seen!
Where the hell had that fucking vorhelm disappeared to?
Could it be...?

chapters.title: Chapter 439: The Battle for the Seals III
paragraphs: "Lian, do you have any idea what we should do—" Kain suddenly stopped in the middle of his sentence and frowned.
His eyes first fell on the place where his best friend had been standing a few moments ago, but now the only thing there was the gray stones of the path.
"Wait a second...where is Lian?"
Rindo, whose full attention had been on Rodrick’s three separated groups, turned his head.
Seraphina, Selina and Marcus also looked around at almost the same time.
No one had an answer.
"I thought he was behind us." Cassian said with a slight frown and checked the path they had come from.
"I was also paying attention to what Rindo was saying and Rodrick’s people." Seraphina frowned slightly.
Knowing Lian, his disappearance for no reason did not seem like good news.
Kain searched around for a few more seconds, then rubbed his palm over his face and let out a heavy sigh.
"God knows where that bastard disappeared to this time." He said with an expression between tiredness and helplessness.
The Student Council President thought for a moment, but unlike him, there was no real worry on his face.
"I don’t think we need to worry about him, among all the people currently inside this test, Lian is probably the last person who needs our help."
Liana also nodded.
"That’s right...I mean, even death couldn’t kill him." Liana said with a small smile, but behind that joke was a memory that could still send a cold shiver through her body.
"So why exactly should we worry about what a school test can do to him?"
For a moment, a heavy silence appeared among the survivors of the Special Area ... because her sentence was ridiculously true.
Kain slowly moved his eyes between their faces, what exactly had they seen that was so crazy that they were this calm now?
"For now, let’s go for the Resistance Seal, if Lian decided to do something else, he probably has his own reason." Rindo nodded and pointed toward the white pillar.
Seraphina gave a short look toward the path where she thought Lian had gone.
She said nothing, but a guess formed in her mind.
Lian rarely did something without a reason, and if he had disappeared exactly when Rodrick’s forces had divided into three groups...
One of those three groups was probably going to have a very bad day.
A few minutes earlier.
Lian had made his decision the moment Rodrick’s large group divided into three sections.
In terms of numbers, they had no chance of copying the same plan.
At best, their group could quickly defeat one Guardian and take one Seal, while Rodrick had more than seventy people and could challenge three Seals at the same time.
If even two of his groups succeeded, the Second Stage would almost go exactly the way he wanted.
He was not going to allow that.
"If we don’t have enough people for three groups..." He said while walking down another stone path, keeping his eyes on one of the distant pillars, the corner of his lips slightly rose.
"Then we simply don’t need to have a group for each Seal."
One person could also be a group.
Blue lightning wrapped around his legs.
Thunder Step.
Boom!
The stone under his foot cracked and his body shot forward at high speed, his target was simple, one of Rodrick’s three Seals.
And among them, the group moving toward the blue pillar was the best choice.
The Speed Seal.
Less than five minutes later, Young Vorhelm reached the destination island.

The blue pillar was shooting straight into the sky from the center of a huge field in the distance, but what caught his attention more was the more than twenty students who had gathered outside the Guardian’s area.
Rodrick’s group and the person standing in front of them were also completely familiar to Lian.
Darren.
Darren was explaining something to several of his people when the sound of heavy armor made him turn his head.
When he saw Young Vorhelm, he paused for a moment, then that same annoying old smile appeared on his face.

"Oh? You haven’t been eliminated yet? Honestly, I thought with Level 23, the First Stage itself would make things easy for us and eliminate you, but it seems you’re like a cockroach that just refuses to die easily."
Several people behind him laughed, some others thought his words were stupid but still laughed to fit in with the group.
Lian showed no reaction to the insult, his eyes passed over Darren and settled on the blue pillar and the battle area.
"You came for this Seal?"
Darren looked like he could not believe the question was serious for a moment.
"No, we came here for a walk...obviously we came for the Seal."
"Good, then I have a proposal." It was time to use his negotiation skills, although he himself did not know if he even had such skills.
The laughter did not become quieter, it became even louder.

"Excuse me? A proposal? What kind of proposal could someone like you have for us, get lost and stop bothering us...if it wasn’t because it would look bad for us to bully a weakling, you would have been finished by now."
"I’ll go first." But Lian ignored those words and said what he wanted anyway, pointing toward the battle area with his finger.
This time there was silence for a few seconds, and then loud laughter came from the group.
"You want to go alone? Are you joking?" One of the students asked in disbelief.
"Without any other student." Lian corrected him and his tone did not even change.
Darren lowered his head and laughed ... he really laughed.
"Are you serious? If you really think a Level 23 Awakened can defeat a Royal Seal Guardian alone, then that Special Area damaged your head much more than I thought."
They did not know the Guardian’s Level, but when the test made them form teams for this Stage, it was clear that they were not going to face a simple enemy.
"Then that should be good news for you." Young Vorhelm shrugged.
"Why?"
"Because you can make a bet, you remember our first bet, right? You lost like a dog, don’t you think you can get your revenge now?"
"What bet?" Darren’s smile slightly disappeared and this time his gaze became more focused, coldness appeared in his eyes.
"You tell me." Lian answered calmly.
He was silent for a few seconds, then gave a short look at the people behind him, almost all the forces Rodrick had given to him were there.
If this madman was giving him such a chance to humiliate him himself, he saw no reason to refuse it.

"Ten minutes, if you can’t defeat the Guardian in less than ten minutes and return with the Seal, you will kneel in front of all of us and admit that compared to me, you’re nothing but a dog." He paused for a moment and his smile returned.
"And after that, you will stop acting in front of Rodrick." He set the ten-minute condition just to be sure.
Because he was worried that maybe this boy had something that gave him confidence, but whatever he had, there was no way he could win in ten minutes.
The people around them looked at Lian with interest, this bet was almost social suicide for someone who intended to enter the battle area alone.
But his expression did not change even a little.
"Deal."
"That’s it?" Darren did not expect such a quick answer.

"No, now my condition, if I return with the Seal before ten minutes, you will get on all fours, walk three full rounds in front of these same people and bark like a dog ... loudly and clearly, I don’t want to have to teach you how a dog makes a sound later."
A short laugh came from the back of the group, the student who had laughed immediately closed his mouth.
Darren’s face became red for a moment, if he backed down now, he would be humiliated in front of all the people who had been given to him to command.
"Deal, ten minutes, if it takes even one second longer, you lose." In the end he clenched his teeth and accepted.
"Good, then watch the clock carefully." Lian also turned to go toward the Guardian.
The moment his foot crossed the boundary, a wall of silver mist appeared behind him.
Within a few seconds, the entire field was hidden from the sight of the people outside, no one outside the area could see the battle.
The only thing that remained was the timer, and inside the field, he looked at the panel in front of him.
[Royal Trial has begun.]
[Speed Seal.]
[Related Stat: Speed.]
[Speed will be completely sealed.]
Before the rule became active, Lian opened his status panel, there was a decision he had delayed for some time.
But here, there was no reason to keep his points anymore.
[Stats Points: 550]
His eyes moved over the Stats.
[Physical Strength: 1000]
[Spirit: 500]
[Speed: 700]
[Resistance: 725]
It was time to use them.

chapters.title: Chapter 440: The Battle for the Seals IV
paragraphs: This time he did not put even a single point into Speed, because in a few seconds that Stat would become completely useless.
[300 Points added to Physical Strength.]
[100 Points added to Spirit.]
[150 Points added to Mana.]
[Stats Points: 0]
[Physical Strength: 1300]
[Spirit: 600]
[Speed: 700]
[Resistance: 725]

The change was almost immediate, his muscles became denser, the flow of Mana through his body moved heavier and with more volume like a river that had suddenly become deeper, and his mind also became slightly clearer.
But he had not even had time to fully check the changes when the next notification appeared.
[Speed: Locked.]
At that moment, a strange feeling appeared in his body, it was not that his legs had become paralyzed but something that had always existed between his decision and movement suddenly disappeared.
His body was still extremely powerful, but his natural acceleration, fast reactions and movements that came from 700 Speed Points were no longer there.
Lian took one step and it was slow, very slow compared to what he was used to.
"Well...this one is really annoying." It was not like he could do anything about it, so he had to get used to it.
Maybe this was a kind of training itself? It could prepare him for a situation in the future if he faced something like this.
Crack!
A heavy sound came from the center of the field.
He raised his head, a creature was sitting on a stone platform.
It was three meters tall, but unlike its size, its body was not heavy or bulky.
Dry and compact muscles could be seen under its dark gray fur and parts of its shoulders, back and forearms were covered with broken golden armor.
Its eyes were completely white, a long scarf was behind its neck and it moved slowly even though there was no wind.
In its right hand was a black staff more than four meters long.
[Royal Seal Guardian.]
[Sky-Treading War Ape.]
[Rank: Unholy.]
[Level: 20 ( Pre- Evoulation ) ]
Lian stayed silent for a few seconds.
Thirty-five.
And Unholy Rank!
He had only encountered an Unholy once before in his life and that was the Dreadmaw Sovereign, and that one was real.
He doubted that a simulated Unholy could truly have and show power equal to a real one, Unholies were not creatures that could be simulated.
At best, this thing only had 60-70 percent of a real Unholy’s power and it was definitely closer to 60 percent than 70.
But now he understood why a group was needed to advance in this Stage.
And this time, his biggest movement advantage was also locked.
The War Ape slowly stood up, spun the staff in its hand and then hit the ground once with its tip.
Boom.
Lian did not even blink and the creature disappeared, it was not just about speed and moving quickly, to his current eyes it had truly disappeared.
His instincts screamed and at the same moment he turned his head to the right.
But it was too late...
The staff hit the side of the World-Devourer Bastion.
Booooooom!
The ground under Lian’s feet exploded and his body was thrown several meters into the air and rolled hard across the stone.
If he had not been wearing the Ancient armor, that attack would probably have crushed all the ribs on his right side in an instant and damaged part of his internal organs.
Young Vorhelm put his hand on the ground and stopped himself.
[Mountain Frame activated.]
The main force of the attack had been spread through the entire structure of the armor, however, a deep pain remained in his side.
"Alright, you’re one of those that needs to be taken seriously." The small smile on his face disappeared.
This battle was not going to be one of those that he could enjoy, instead he had to use all his power if he wanted to win.
A sound like a rough laugh came from the Guardian’s throat and then seven more images of itself appeared beside its body.
Eight apes.
And eight staffs.
[Eightfold Pursuit.]
And they all moved, Lian had no chance of following them with his normal speed.
So he did not even try and lowered his hand.
Frost Dominion.
Cold spread through the entire field like a silent explosion and in less than a second, a smooth layer of ice formed over the ground.
Just enough so that nothing could pass without touching it and at the same time the eight images approached from eight directions.
Seven of them left no mark on the ice.
But one ...Crack!
A small crack appeared under its foot.
"Found you."
True Sequence.
Lian’s eyes caught the movement flow of the real creature.
Thunder Calamity.
Purple and blue lightning burst through the plates of his armor, this time it did not only cover his fist but spread around his entire body.
Krrrrrrraaaack!
The lightning wave spread through the icy field and the seven images disappeared instantly, the real ape appeared right in front of him.
But Young Vorhelm’s smile lasted only for a moment ...the creature was not on the ground at all! It had created that crack on purpose.
"Damn it! Fuck, fuck." He looked up and the ape came down from above him.
It was holding the staff with both hands.
[Hell-Splitting Staff.]
"Damn it—" Lian had no time to escape and planted his feet firmly into the ground.
[Mountain Anchor.]
Both of his forearms went up and the staff came down at the same time.
Booooooooooom!
The entire field shook and the stone sank within a radius of dozens of meters, cracks like a spider web spread under Lian’s feet and the layer of ice he had created broke into thousands of pieces.
His knees bent for a moment and the World-Devourer Bastion made a deep metal sound, a crack appeared on the shoulder plate.
[Structural Damage detected.]
[Structural Memory activated.]
His lips split open and the taste of blood filled his mouth.
But he did not fall, he did everything he could to resist the attack.
The ape pressed down on its staff for a moment, as if it was surprised.
Lian raised his head.
"I admit your speed." Lightning moved between his armored fingers and a cold smile appeared on his face again.
"But you have one problem."
The ape disappeared and this time appeared behind him.
"No matter how fast you are...in the end, you have to get close to kill me." His palm turned backward.
Cataclysm Pulse.
Boom!
The destructive wave exploded from less than one meter away and the ape could not completely escape, part of the explosion hit its chest directly and its body was thrown backward like a bullet.
But before hitting the ground, it turned in the air and landed on its staff.
It was still unharmed.
"One." Lian frowned slightly, this was not a battle he could win alone.
Hive Dominion.
The space beside him twisted.
The giant ant appeared among the particles of light and its claws hit the field with a heavy impact.
[Special Member: One.]
[Entering the Speed Seal Trial.]
[Speed: Locked.]
One’s reaction was immediate, its movement became heavier, much heavier, the speed it normally used to reach enemies was gone, but its natural armor, physical strength and huge body were still there.
Young Vorhelm sent only one command through the link... Block its path!
The giant ant understood immediately and at the same time the ape moved again.
Cloudstep Mirage.
Dozens of images appeared across the field but this time Lian was no longer alone and One blocked the eastern side of the field with its huge body.
Lian covered the other side with ice and the ape was forced to choose one of the limited paths to attack.
Young Vorhelm waited.
And suddenly a crack appeared on the left! Without hesitation, he sent lightning toward it.
Boom!
The ape changed its path but just in time One lowered its huge claw, the Guardian had no choice and jumped over it and this was exactly what Lian wanted.
Frost Dominion.
An ice pillar formed in the path of its jump.
The ape swung its staff and broke it, but this collision slowed it down for a moment.
Thunder Step.
Even with his Speed locked, he threw himself forward with the force of the Skill, his movement was much slower than normal.
But it was enough and the fist covered in Thunder Calamity hit the ape directly in the stomach.
Boom!
Lightning came out from the back of its body and the Guardian moved several meters backward and Lian wanted to continue when suddenly the wind around the field changed.
The ape spun the staff in the air.
Once.
Twice.
Three times.
A circular storm formed around the field.
[Storm Ring.]
Wind hit from all four directions with terrifying pressure and the ice plates were torn from the ground.
One was forced to push its claws into the stone and Young Vorhelm also placed the weight of the armor on his feet.
The creature disappeared into the storm and suddenly an attack came from the left toward him which he blocked with his forearm.
Crack!

A second one came from behind but he was not fast enough and the armor was hit, before he had a chance to react, a third one came from above...although One brought its head forward and the staff hit its head armor.
Boom!
The giant ant fell onto one knee and cold anger appeared in Lian’s eyes for a moment.
"One, back."
The ant did not reject the command, it only changed its position and placed its body between its master and the next path.
The ape came for the fourth attack and Lian clenched his teeth.
True Sequence.
This time instead of following the ape’s body, he studied its attack pattern.
Eight attacks:...always eight angles, but their order changed every time.
There was another common point, before the seventh attack, the creature landed on the real surface for a fraction of a second to create its final acceleration.
That was enough.
Fifth.
Sixth.
Lian remained still and waited ...then
Seventh.
Crack!
"Now."
One put all its weight on that same point and the ape was forced to change its path exactly when it landed, Frost Dominion also locked its other foot in the ice at the same time.
But it could only trap it for one second and the ape broke the ice ...and it was already too late.
The sky suddenly became darker, the creature raised its staff, a huge amount of Mana gathered around it and the staff started to grow.
Five meters.
Ten meters.
Twenty meters.
Its shadow covered almost the entire field.
[Falling.]
Lian’s eyes narrowed for a moment, with his Speed locked, escaping the area was almost impossible.
So he did not run.
The best defense is offense.
( Scene visualization )

[Speed: Locked.]
At that moment, a strange feeling appeared in his body, it was not that his legs had become paralyzed but something that had always existed between his decision and movement suddenly disappeared.
His body was still extremely powerful, but his natural acceleration, fast reactions and movements that came from 700 Speed Points were no longer there.
Lian took one step and it was slow, very slow compared to what he was used to.
"Well...this one is really annoying." It was not like he could do anything about it, so he had to get used to it.
Maybe this was a kind of training itself?
It could prepare him for a situation in the future if he faced something like this.
Crack!
A heavy sound came from the center of the field.
He raised his head, a creature was sitting on a stone platform.
It was three meters tall, but unlike its size, its body was not heavy or bulky.
Dry and compact muscles could be seen under its dark gray fur and parts of its shoulders, back and forearms were covered with broken golden armor.
Its eyes were completely white, a long scarf was behind its neck and it moved slowly even though there was no wind.
In its right hand was a black staff more than four meters long.
[Royal Seal Guardian.]
[Sky-Treading War Ape.]
[Rank: Unholy.]
[Level: 20 ( Pre- Evoulation ) ]
Lian stayed silent for a few seconds.
Thirty-five.
And Unholy Rank!
He had only encountered an Unholy once before in his life and that was the Dreadmaw Sovereign, and that one was real.
He doubted that a simulated Unholy could truly have and show power equal to a real one, Unholies were not creatures that could be simulated.
At best, this thing only had 60-70 percent of a real Unholy’s power and it was definitely closer to 60 percent than 70.
But now he understood why a group was needed to advance in this Stage.
And this time, his biggest movement advantage was also locked.
The War Ape slowly stood up, spun the staff in its hand and then hit the ground once with its tip.
Boom.
Lian did not even blink and the creature disappeared, it was not just about speed and moving quickly, to his current eyes it had truly disappeared.
His instincts screamed and at the same moment he turned his head to the right.
But it was too late...
The staff hit the side of the World-Devourer Bastion.
Booooooom!
The ground under Lian’s feet exploded and his body was thrown several meters into the air and rolled hard across the stone.
If he had not been wearing the Ancient armor, that attack would probably have crushed all the ribs on his right side in an instant and damaged part of his internal organs.
Young Vorhelm put his hand on the ground and stopped himself.
[Mountain Frame activated.]
The main force of the attack had been spread through the entire structure of the armor, however, a deep pain remained in his side.
"Alright, you’re one of those that needs to be taken seriously." The small smile on his face disappeared.
This battle was not going to be one of those that he could enjoy, instead he had to use all his power if he wanted to win.
A sound like a rough laugh came from the Guardian’s throat and then seven more images of itself appeared beside its body.
Eight apes.
And eight staffs.
[Eightfold Pursuit.]
And they all moved, Lian had no chance of following them with his normal speed.
So he did not even try and lowered his hand.
Frost Dominion.
Cold spread through the entire field like a silent explosion and in less than a second, a smooth layer of ice formed over the ground.
Just enough so that nothing could pass without touching it and at the same time the eight images approached from eight directions.
Seven of them left no mark on the ice.
But one ...Crack!
A small crack appeared under its foot.
"Found you."
True Sequence.
Lian’s eyes caught the movement flow of the real creature.
Thunder Calamity.
Purple and blue lightning burst through the plates of his armor, this time it did not only cover his fist but spread around his entire body.
Krrrrrrraaaack!
The lightning wave spread through the icy field and the seven images disappeared instantly, the real ape appeared right in front of him.
But Young Vorhelm’s smile lasted only for a moment ...the creature was not on the ground at all!
It had created that crack on purpose.
"Damn it!
Fuck, fuck." He looked up and the ape came down from above him.
It was holding the staff with both hands.
[Hell-Splitting Staff.]
"Damn it—" Lian had no time to escape and planted his feet firmly into the ground.
[Mountain Anchor.]
Both of his forearms went up and the staff came down at the same time.
Booooooooooom!
The entire field shook and the stone sank within a radius of dozens of meters, cracks like a spider web spread under Lian’s feet and the layer of ice he had created broke into thousands of pieces.
His knees bent for a moment and the World-Devourer Bastion made a deep metal sound, a crack appeared on the shoulder plate.
[Structural Damage detected.]
[Structural Memory activated.]
His lips split open and the taste of blood filled his mouth.
But he did not fall, he did everything he could to resist the attack.
The ape pressed down on its staff for a moment, as if it was surprised.
Lian raised his head.
"I admit your speed." Lightning moved between his armored fingers and a cold smile appeared on his face again.
"But you have one problem."
The ape disappeared and this time appeared behind him.
"No matter how fast you are...in the end, you have to get close to kill me." His palm turned backward.
Cataclysm Pulse.
Boom!
The destructive wave exploded from less than one meter away and the ape could not completely escape, part of the explosion hit its chest directly and its body was thrown backward like a bullet.
But before hitting the ground, it turned in the air and landed on its staff.
It was still unharmed.
"One." Lian frowned slightly, this was not a battle he could win alone.
Hive Dominion.
The space beside him twisted.
The giant ant appeared among the particles of light and its claws hit the field with a heavy impact.
[Special Member: One.]
[Entering the Speed Seal Trial.]
[Speed: Locked.]
One’s reaction was immediate, its movement became heavier, much heavier, the speed it normally used to reach enemies was gone, but its natural armor, physical strength and huge body were still there.
Young Vorhelm sent only one command through the link...
Block its path!
The giant ant understood immediately and at the same time the ape moved again.
Cloudstep Mirage.
Dozens of images appeared across the field but this time Lian was no longer alone and One blocked the eastern side of the field with its huge body.
Lian covered the other side with ice and the ape was forced to choose one of the limited paths to attack.
Young Vorhelm waited.
And suddenly a crack appeared on the left!
Without hesitation, he sent lightning toward it.
Boom!
The ape changed its path but just in time One lowered its huge claw, the Guardian had no choice and jumped over it and this was exactly what Lian wanted.
Frost Dominion.
An ice pillar formed in the path of its jump.
The ape swung its staff and broke it, but this collision slowed it down for a moment.
Thunder Step.
Even with his Speed locked, he threw himself forward with the force of the Skill, his movement was much slower than normal.
But it was enough and the fist covered in Thunder Calamity hit the ape directly in the stomach.
Boom!
Lightning came out from the back of its body and the Guardian moved several meters backward and Lian wanted to continue when suddenly the wind around the field changed.
The ape spun the staff in the air.
Once.
Twice.
Three times.
A circular storm formed around the field.
[Storm Ring.]
Wind hit from all four directions with terrifying pressure and the ice plates were torn from the ground.
One was forced to push its claws into the stone and Young Vorhelm also placed the weight of the armor on his feet.
The creature disappeared into the storm and suddenly an attack came from the left toward him which he blocked with his forearm.
Crack!

A second one came from behind but he was not fast enough and the armor was hit, before he had a chance to react, a third one came from above...although One brought its head forward and the staff hit its head armor.
Boom!
The giant ant fell onto one knee and cold anger appeared in Lian’s eyes for a moment.
"One, back."
The ant did not reject the command, it only changed its position and placed its body between its master and the next path.
The ape came for the fourth attack and Lian clenched his teeth.
True Sequence.
This time instead of following the ape’s body, he studied its attack pattern.
Eight attacks:...always eight angles, but their order changed every time.
There was another common point, before the seventh attack, the creature landed on the real surface for a fraction of a second to create its final acceleration.
That was enough.
Fifth.
Sixth.
Lian remained still and waited ...then
Seventh.
Crack!
"Now."
One put all its weight on that same point and the ape was forced to change its path exactly when it landed, Frost Dominion also locked its other foot in the ice at the same time.
But it could only trap it for one second and the ape broke the ice ...and it was already too late.
The sky suddenly became darker, the creature raised its staff, a huge amount of Mana gathered around it and the staff started to grow.
Five meters.
Ten meters.
Twenty meters.
Its shadow covered almost the entire field.
[Falling.]
Lian’s eyes narrowed for a moment, with his Speed locked, escaping the area was almost impossible.
So he did not run.
The best defense is offense.
( Scene visualization )

chapters.title: Chapter 441: The Battle for the Seals V
paragraphs: Lian’s eyes narrowed for a moment, with his Speed locked, escaping from the area was almost impossible.
So he did not run.
The best defense is offense.
"One, left leg."
The ant attacked and its jaws closed around the Guardian’s leg, the ape pulled him with great strength, but One did not let go.
Frost Dominion.
The creature’s right leg was frozen up to the knee, the Guardian growled...the ice was starting to crack and they did not have much time.
One second ... maybe less, but Lian had been ready for this one second.
Thunder Calamity.
Lightning spread from his chest to the arms and legs of the World-Devourer Bastion.
Iron Fortress Charge.
Giant’s Momentum.
The true mass of the Ancient armor gathered behind his movement, the first step broke the ground and the second step sent stones flying into the air.
The third step ... BOOOOOOOOOOOM! Lian crashed into the Guardian like a cannonball.
He did not chase after its speed or try to become faster than it, such a thing was impossible in his current state and he only used all his mass and strength to force the speed out of the path.
His armored shoulder hit the ape’s chest directly and the sound of something breaking under the Guardian’s golden armor spread through the area.
Its three-meter body left the ground and the huge staff lost its path and landed beside them.
BOOOOOOOOOOM!
Half of the battlefield exploded and One immediately released the leg and moved away, the ape was still in the air when Lian extended his right hand.
Cataclysm Pulse.
His palm landed directly on the Guardian’s cracked chest.
"Time to finish this."
BOOOOOOM!

An explosion happened from point-blank range and the Guardian’s golden armor exploded from the middle, its body was thrown several dozen meters and crashed into the stone pillar at the end of the battlefield.
The pillar broke and the ape fell among the stones ...it did not move for two seconds and then its finger moved.
"Still?" Lian let out a heavy breath.
It was true that this thing was not a real Unholy, but it was still a simulation of one and that was enough to make it different from any other monster.
The ape tried to stand up.
The young Vorhelm did not wait this time, if he gave it even the smallest chance to recover, he might get into trouble again.
Thunder Step.
He threw himself forward and his right fist was covered with Thunder Calamity.
Crack!
His fist went into the monster’s chest and lightning came out from every crack in the Guardian’s body.
Finally ...its white eyes went dark and its body slowly fell onto its knees.
[Speed Seal Guardian defeated.]
[Test completed.]
[Completion Time: 07:41.]
He stood there for a few moments.
Seven minutes and forty-one seconds.
His smile returned, this had been good training against an Unholy, but unfortunately it was not a real Unholy ...he was interested to know if he could defeat one of them now?
When fighting a real Unholy, there would be many unknown factors and predicting it would not be easy, they had the ability to think and that was the biggest unknown factor.
The blue seal separated from the center of the battlefield and landed in his hand.
[Speed Seal obtained.]
He looked at One, it had not received any serious new injuries, but the pressure of the battle and having its Speed locked had tired its body.
"Good job, thank you for your help, go back and rest." He placed his hand on its large head for a moment.
The giant ant sent a warm feeling of satisfaction through the link and its body turned into particles of light.
[One has returned to the Colony House.]
Outside the battlefield, Darren was still smiling.
For the first three minutes, he was almost certain.
Even at the fourth minute, nothing had changed ...but at five minutes, his smile became smaller ...six minutes and one of his men kept looking at the timer.
And then it reached seven minutes...
"Why hasn’t he lost yet?" one of the students asked with a frown.
No one answered, they were also shocked, they had not expected him to last this long.
Darren was no longer smiling.
The silver mist around the battlefield shook.
The wall opened and at the same time a noticeable silence covered the area.
Lian walked out of the mist, his movement was calm and he did not look like someone who had just escaped from a deadly battle in a hurry, but more like someone who had finished his job.
But what made everyone’s eyes stop immediately was his left hand.
The blue seal ...the Speed Seal ...was in his hand ...?
No one laughed, no one even spoke, they were so shocked that their minds could not understand how they should react.
Darren stared at the seal for several seconds, the color slowly left his face.
No.
This was impossible.
Level 23!.
He alone ...had defeated the Royal Seal Guardian in seven minutes ...? Had he finally become so stressed from life that he was hallucinating?
Lian stopped in front of them and looked at the timer, then at him.
"Seven minutes and forty-one seconds, I think I still have two minutes and nineteen seconds left."
His lips opened slightly but no sound came out, he did not know what to say...what could he say?
Lian walked past him.
"Where are you going?!" Darren suddenly came back to his senses and shouted louder than he had intended.
"I have to go for the other Seals." The young Vorhelm did not even stop.
Darren was stunned for a moment, but this was good, maybe this guy really did not care about their bet? Maybe he really did not need to worry about social death?
But he was being too optimistic ...
Lian suddenly turned his head toward him and a calm smile appeared on his face.
"Don’t worry about the bet, I’ll come back later, until then practice getting on all fours, your barking also needs to be acceptable, I don’t want to make you do it again."
Several people from Rodrick’s group lowered their eyes, one of them barely held back his laughter but there was nothing funny about this for Darren.
This was not just losing a bet, he had been humiliated in front of more than twenty people from his own faction.
And if this story spread outside the test...
No!
When it spread, he would be finished!
"Rodrick won’t let this go unanswered!" he shouted with a red face.
"Good, I’m looking forward to seeing him." But the young Vorhelm answered without turning back.
Lightning wrapped around his legs and boom! He disappeared.
Darren stood there, for the first time, threatening someone with Rodrick’s name had no effect.
Worse than that, Lian had not even stopped to hear it.
After leaving the area of the Speed Seal battlefield, his locked stat was free again.
[Speed: 700]
The difference was so great that his first use of Thunder Step again almost felt like flying, he could really feel the importance of Speed now.
He crossed one of the newly built bridges and checked the condition of the Seals at the same time.
[Speed Seal — Captured.]
[Strength Seal — In Contest.]
[Mana Seal — In Contest.]
[Resistance Seal — In Contest.]
[Spirit Seal — In Contest.]
His eyes moved toward two distant pillars, before separating, he had seen the paths of Rodrick’s three groups, the main group had gone toward the Strength Seal, Rodrick himself was there.
The second group had been led by Elena toward the Mana Seal and both battles had already started and the walls of the battle areas had already formed.
Entering them was impossible until the challenge ended and they had a good chance of winning, so there was no need to waste time.
So only one Seal remained.
Spirit Seal.
When he reached the island of the Spirit Seal, the battle was still going on.
About ten students were standing outside the silver wall and looking anxiously at the thick mist in front of them.
It was probably another group of friends or members of the same faction who were inside.
Lian had just gotten close when the wall suddenly shook.
Boom!
White light exploded from inside it and the first student was pushed out as particles of light.
Then the second.
The third.
The fourth.
In less than ten seconds, eight people were thrown out of the test one after another.
[Challenge failed.]
[Spirit Seal Guardian resetting.]
The expressions of the people outside changed and one of them immediately raised his hand when he saw the young Vorhelm.
"Wait! That thing isn’t normal, even when—"
"I know." Lian walked past him.
"No, you don’t understand! When your Spirit is locked, its illusions—"
The wall closed behind him and the student’s voice was cut off, he did not even have time to finish his warning.
The Spirit Seal battlefield was almost completely silent unlike the Speed Seal battlefield, the black and smooth ground stretched under his feet like a huge mirror.
There was no wind and no sound, and in the center of the battlefield, a humanoid creature was sitting cross-legged on the ground.
It was about two meters tall.
A torn white and black robe covered its body and a cracked mask without eyes covered its face.
Six metal rings floated in the air behind its head and a long staff rested across its knees.
[Royal Trial has begun.]
[Spirit Seal.]
[Related Stat: Spirit.]
[Spirit will be completely sealed.]
Lian let out a short breath.
[Spirit: 600 → Locked.]
The change was much more unpleasant this time, it was as if a layer of clarity had been removed from everything.
The Mana flows that he could normally sense easily became unclear, even his fine control over ice felt heavier for a moment.
Lian activated True Sequence.
Information came, but it was broken and incomplete, parts of the paths disappeared and some starting and ending points could not be recognized.
"Looks like losing this one isn’t fun either." Lian muttered, but he had already expected it, Spirit could be very important.
The creature in front of him slowly raised its head.
[Royal Seal Guardian.]
[Mirror-Soul Ascetic.]
[Rank: Unholy.]
[Level: 20 (Pre-Evolution).]
The Rank and Level of this one were exactly the same as before and there was nothing to explain or check again.
One of the six rings behind its head began to spin.
Click.
A very weak sound echoed, but in the next moment the entire battlefield was filled with it.
Ten Ascetics.
Twenty.
Fifty.
One hundred.
They were all completely identical, perfect copies that were the same as the original in even the smallest details.
[Hundred Echo Bodies.]
Lian looked around him, none of them looked different from the others.
"One, I need your help again."
Light formed beside him and the giant ant appeared again.
[Spirit: Locked.]
The connection between them remained, but its usual clarity had decreased.
The young Vorhelm could no longer receive every sensory detail from One as accurately as before.
It did not matter.
The Ascetics moved at the same time and he lowered his hand.
Frost Dominion.
Cold spread across the entire battlefield, but this time his control was not as precise as before and the ice formed thicker in some places and thinner in others.
However, it was enough for his purpose, hundreds of feet moved across the battlefield but only a few of them cracked the ice.
"Illusions." Lian ignored the paths of the bodies that had no physical effect.
One also detected one of the real bodies and rushed toward it, but just before the collision, one of the rings behind the main Ascetic in the distance spun.
Ding.
[Soul Bell.]
The sound was almost quiet but it felt like his brain had been hit from the inside for a moment.
The world spun!
Up became down!
Right looked like left for a fraction of a second.
Lian took one wrong step and at that exact moment a palm appeared from empty space beside his side.
[Empty Palm.]
BOOOOOOM!

The young Vorhelm could no longer receive every sensory detail from One as accurately as before.
It did not matter.
The Ascetics moved at the same time and he lowered his hand.
Frost Dominion.
Cold spread across the entire battlefield, but this time his control was not as precise as before and the ice formed thicker in some places and thinner in others.
However, it was enough for his purpose, hundreds of feet moved across the battlefield but only a few of them cracked the ice.
"Illusions." Lian ignored the paths of the bodies that had no physical effect.
One also detected one of the real bodies and rushed toward it, but just before the collision, one of the rings behind the main Ascetic in the distance spun.
Ding.
[Soul Bell.]
The sound was almost quiet but it felt like his brain had been hit from the inside for a moment.
The world spun!
Up became down!
Right looked like left for a fraction of a second.
Lian took one wrong step and at that exact moment a palm appeared from empty space beside his side.
[Empty Palm.]
BOOOOOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 442: The Battle for the Seals Final ( PS Bonus - )
paragraphs: BOOM!
The attack hit the World-Devourer Bastion directly and his body was thrown nearly fifteen meters, he rolled across the icy ground.
Mountain Frame spread a large part of the impact, but a deep pain twisted through his side.
If he did not have the armor, with his normal Resistance and without Spirit to predict the attack, several bones would probably have broken at that moment.
On the other side, One also reached one of the fake bodies and the figure disappeared at the moment of impact.
"Alright...this one is really annoying." He stood up from the ground and wiped a very small amount of blood from the corner of his lips.
He already missed that ape, at least against it he could crush his enemy with physical strength, but this damn thing was not going to be defeated by that method alone.
The main Ascetic showed no reaction and the second ring rotated, suddenly the entire surface of the battlefield changed.
The ground became a reflection of the sky and the sky also reflected the ground and ...the horizon disappeared.
[Mirror Heaven.]
For a moment, Lian really did not know which direction was down, hundreds of figures appeared around him in every direction.
On the ground.
In the sky.
On invisible walls.
One roared and pushed its claws into the ice to keep its balance, the poor ant was experiencing something that it had never thought was even possible.
Suddenly an Ascetic came from behind and Lian punched after sensing it...but it was only an illusion.
A second one appeared from above and he raised his forearm and this one was real!
Clang!
The staff hit his armor and at the same time the third...fourth and fifth also appeared from different directions!
Small but continuous attacks came from every direction and the worst part of the battle was not that the Guardian was stronger than him.
It was that Lian could no longer understand exactly what he should attack.
True Sequence gave insufficient information.
Spirit was zero.
The accuracy of Frost Dominion had decreased and every time the Guardian found a way for him to identify the fake copies, it changed the structure of the illusions.
One of the rings made a sound again.
Ding!
Lian’s head went empty for a moment and suddenly three Empty Palms appeared at the same time.
One hit toward his shoulder, another hit his chest and finally one hit his back.
BOOM!
BOOM!
BOOOOOOM!
The young Vorhelm was pushed several meters back across the ice and the armor plates made a painful sound.
[Structural Damage detected.]
Silver lines lit up.
[Structural Memory activated.]
He took a deep breath and then suddenly stopped, he no longer searched for the original body, he understood that doing this was only a waste of time and foolishness.
"Alright, if you won’t let me find you..." Huge Mana began to move inside his body and a different kind of cold formed around him..
"Then I’ll hit all of you together."
Eternal Frozen Apocalypse.
BOOOOOOM!
The cold exploded and spread everywhere like a wave that stopped the world for a moment.
The mirror-like surface of the battlefield turned white in the blink of an eye and pillars of ice rose from the ground, the air around them became full of frozen particles.
Hundreds of images were trapped in the ice, some broke immediately, some were still able to move and the main Ascetic was also forced to move from his position.
Lian did not see it but he did not need to.
[Thunder Calamity.]
Blue and purple lightning came out from his entire body and reached the ice.
KRRRRRRRRAAAAAACK!
The entire battlefield turned into a network of lightning and the electric current spread in every direction through the connected ice.
Dozens of copies exploded in one moment and the sound of breaking mirrors spread across the battlefield like falling glass.
However, one of the figures reacted differently, the lightning hit it, its body moved backward but it did not disappear.
"Found you."
One saw it at the same moment and the giant ant passed through the ice pillars and threw itself at the Ascetic.
Its jaws closed around the lower half of his body, the Ascetic lowered his staff and at the same time the third ring made a sound.
Ding!
An invisible wave hit One and the giant ant’s large body left the ground and was thrown several meters backward.
But this one moment was enough to buy time and let Lian move.
[Iron Fortress Charge.]
[Giant’s Momentum.]

The World-Devourer Bastion placed all of its true mass behind his movement and the ice under the young Vorhelm’s feet broke, the sound of every step spread across the battlefield like a cannon explosion.
The Ascetic raised his hand.
[Empty Palm.]
Lian also extended his hand forward.
[Cataclysm Pulse.]
The two forces collided less than five meters apart.
BOOOOOOOOOOOM!
Part of the icy battlefield exploded and a cloud of mist and broken ice covered everything.
But he came out from inside it, his armor was cracked, part of his shoulder had been pushed inward but he had not stopped.
The Ascetic took one step back and at the same time all six rings behind his head rotated together.
All the remaining copies formed again.
Hundreds of figures and this time their presence was heavier and more real.
[Ten Thousand Reflections, One Body.]
All the copies raised their hands.
"You’re doing too much, wouldn’t it be better to just give up?" Lian looked at the scene for a moment.
One stood up again and its master gave it a short look.
One command.
Go behind him.
The giant ant moved despite its exhaustion and injuries and blocked the Guardian’s retreat path.
At the same time, hundreds of Ascetics attacked and Lian placed his palm on the icy ground.
Frost Dominion.
Walls of ice rose from all four sides and hundreds of copies were forced to gather in a few limited paths.
Thunder Calamity exploded again.
KRRRRAAAAAACK!
The copies exploded one after another along the narrow paths and the main Ascetic jumped over one of the walls.
At that moment One hit him from below and his balance was disturbed for a fraction of a second.
Lian had been waiting for this.
Thunder Step.
Even with his Spirit locked, his Speed was now free and with it he reached the Guardian in front of him in an instant.
His right hand was covered in ice.
Glacial Reaper Claw.
The Ascetic raised his staff and the ice blades collided with the staff.
Clang!
Two blades broke but the third passed through the defense and cut the Ascetic’s cracked mask.
There was nothing under the mask except white light and whatever that creature was, it was forced to retreat again.
The rings behind its head started to shake and Lian did not give it another chance, Thunder Calamity gathered on his right fist.
The giant ant came from behind and closed its jaws around the Ascetic’s arm and the Guardian tried to activate another ring.
And at the same time, the young Vorhelm punched.
BOOOOOOM!
The punch hit the chest directly, lightning entered the body and a crack spread from the center of the chest across the entire robe.
But it was still not enough.
The Ascetic placed his palm on his head.
Empty Palm.
Lian’s eyes opened slightly wider.
If this attack exploded from point-blank range, even the World-Devourer Bastion would not be able to block all the force without serious damage.
Lian locked his left hand around that hand and did not let it pull away and a calm smile appeared on his face.
"If I’m going to take this...you’re taking it with me."
Cataclysm Pulse.
His palm landed on the Guardian’s split-open chest and both attacks activated almost at the same time.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOM!
The explosion swallowed the battlefield.
One released itself and jumped backward a few moments before the impact, following Lian’s command.
The young Vorhelm’s body was thrown several meters, his back hit the ice and a long path was dragged across the ground.
The chest plates of the armor were deeply pushed inward, his ears rang for several seconds and blood came from his ears, nose and eyes.
His vision became unclear and his head started spinning badly.
He felt like his skull had broken and he could barely move it, blood filled his entire mouth.
But he was still conscious and without delay, he immediately took out a healing potion that he had bought from the Academy Store yesterday from his storage space and drank it.
After drinking it, he felt the pain in his skull slowly start to disappear.
On the other side of the battlefield, the Ascetic was standing.
One second.
Two seconds.
Then the crack in the center of his chest lit up.
Crack.
The six rings behind his head stopped moving one after another and his body fell to its knees and all the copies around him cracked at the same time.
And then they broke.
Thousands of particles of light spread across the frozen battlefield.
[Spirit Seal Guardian defeated.]
[Test completed.]
Lian stayed on the ground for several seconds and then let out a deep sigh.
"That was really annoying." And then he stood up with the small amount of pain that remained.
One approached, its natural chest armor had a deep scratch and it was also bleeding from several places and its condition did not look good.
But it was not bad enough to say that it was between life and death.
"Good job and thanks again." The young Vorhelm patted it and at the same time took out two healing potions and gave them to it.
A feeling of pride and satisfaction passed through the link from One.
"Go back and rest."
One’s body dissolved into light.
[One has returned to the Colony House.]
A seal rose from the central platform and came toward Lian.
[Spirit Seal obtained.]
He took it and at that moment several new notifications appeared in front of him.
[Resistance Seal — Captured.]
[Holder: Rindo Valcrest.]
He stood still for a moment and then looked at the Speed Seal in his storage space, the Spirit Seal in his hand and the Resistance Seal notification in front of his eyes.
They had finally obtained three Seals.
The corner of his lips rose and suddenly a laugh came from his throat.
Rodrick had gathered more than seventy people, created three groups and targeted three Seals at the same time and in the end Lian alone had taken two Seals from under everyone’s hands.
And his friends had taken the third one.
He raised his eyes.
Behind the battlefield wall, the central upside-down mountain was still floating in the sky and the golden crown was shining above it.
Three notifications appeared together.
[Speed Seal — Held by Lian Vorhelm.]
[Spirit Seal — Held by Lian Vorhelm.]
[Resistance Seal — Held by Rindo Valcrest.]
( Scene visualization )

chapters.title: Chapter 443: Pay the Bet
paragraphs: [Gate Condition fulfilled.]
A deep roar spread across the entire realm.
The huge upside-down mountain that had remained still in the center of the sky since the beginning of the test suddenly shook.
Pieces of stone broke away from its lower surface and fell into the sea of black clouds, while lines of golden light came out through the cracks in the mountain.
However, no path toward it appeared.
Lian, who had just left the Spirit Seal battlefield, fixed his eyes on the mountain.
Several more notifications appeared in front of his eyes.
[Three Royal Seals are in the hands of one alliance.]
[Conditions for opening the central path fulfilled.]
[Transfer the Royal Seals to the Central Gate.]
[The first three Seals placed in the Gate will open the path to the upside-down mountain.]
It was still not over and the next notification showed why collecting more than one Seal had been useful.
[Active Participation Reward activated.]
[The alliance that places the highest number of Royal Seals in the Gate will receive additional points.]
"So there are even bonus points for who opens the gate." He muttered to himself and once again realized the importance of points.
Apart from the points, almost everyone’s eyes were on the broken crown on the upside-down mountain and they thought it would decide the final winner and first place.
But something told him that there was something wrong with that crown.
At that moment, the ground in the distance shook and several kilometers ahead, on the last island connected to the central path, a huge crack opened in the ground.
Two black pillars came out from the rock.
Ten meters.
Twenty meters.
Thirty meters.
Until the height of each one passed fifty meters.
Between them, a stone arch slowly formed and a dark golden surface filled the empty space inside it, something like still water with no waves on its surface.
At the bottom of the arch, three stone platforms also rose from the ground and each one had a place for a Seal.
Only three places.
Behind the Gate there was still nothing and only empty space, the sea of black clouds and the upside-down mountain floating kilometers away in the sky.
Lian looked at the scene for several seconds and then opened his points panel.
[Points: 994.]
His eyebrow rose slightly.
"Nine hundred and ninety-four..."
Before entering the second stage, he had not even reached four hundred, but two Royal Seal Guardians, two Seals and his performance in the battles had caused his points to almost triple.
The main question was where everyone else stood.
How many points did Rodrick have?
He knew the points of his friends, and it was unlikely that they had changed much.
And maybe there was only one person who had a chance of having points close to his, and even that person was unlikely to have a performance anywhere near his.
But in any case, the answer did not matter for now and he headed toward the Gate.
About ten minutes later, Lian found his group of friends.
Even before getting completely close, it was clear that the battle against the Resistance Seal Guardian had been hard enough for them.
A temporary bandage was wrapped around Rindo’s right arm and a red spot was slowly appearing under the cloth.
Seraphina was sitting beside a large rock and pouring a healing potion over the deep cut on her shoulder.
Kain’s armor was torn at the side and a large bruise covered almost the entire left side of his body.
Ethan was wiping the dried blood under his nose with the back of his hand and Marcus was drinking the last bit of a recovery potion with an unhappy expression.
Even Liana’s Silvercrest Gryphon had not escaped without injuries.
Several long feathers on its right wing were broken and there was a mark from a heavy hit on the natural armor of its chest.
Selina was bandaging the wound on Cassian’s forearm when the sound of the heavy steps of Ancient armor spread along the path.
Everyone raised their heads and Liana was the first to smile.
"Finally, there he is."
Kain immediately turned around.
"Where did you disappear—" His words stopped halfway and his eyes fell on the young Vorhelm’s hands.
There were two Seals in his hands!
They had heard it from the system notification, but seeing it with their own eyes ...was even more shocking.
For several seconds, his mind seemed unwilling to accept what he was seeing.
"Wait a second...are these two both real?"
"As far as I know, yeah."
Kain first looked at the Seals, then at the rest of the group and then back at Lian.

"We all went and got one Seal, all of us! We had to go through so much trouble just to defeat one Guardian and ...you got two during the same amount of time?" He thought that the distance between him and his best friend had disappeared.
But it seemed that it had not only failed to disappear, it had reached an unbelievable level instead ...how was something like this even possible?
"That doesn’t matter, what matters is that we have three Seals now." Lian was too lazy to answer and he really had no idea how he could explain it in a logical way.
Seraphina stood up and her eyes stayed on the two Seals for a few moments before slowly settling on his face.
He had defeated two Guardians in almost the same amount of time as all of them had needed to fight one Guardian.
She already knew that the difference between Lian and the others was large.
But every time she thought she had finally understood the real size of that difference, this boy did something that made her previous estimate look ridiculous.
Rindo also said nothing but his calculating eyes had reached almost the same conclusion.
"Well...at least we don’t have to worry about whether we have three Seals anymore." He finally added and brought them back to the main matter.
"Now we have to worry about who reaches the Gate before us." Lian reminded them of an important point.
If Rodrick arrived earlier and placed two Seals into the platforms, his group could still get the highest points from this part.
That sentence was enough to end the jokes and the Student Council President immediately nodded.
"We move, drink your potions while we go, we don’t know how much time we will have after the Gate opens."
The group started moving again.
The farther they went, the larger the huge upside-down mountain became, from this distance it was no longer just a black mass in the sky.
Huge floating rocks could be seen around it and several strange rivers flowed across its surface, rivers that moved upward from the lower part of the mountain against gravity.
Chains as thick as buildings hung from different parts of it, but some of them were connected to nothing and their ends floated in empty space.
Ruins could also be seen on the surface of the mountain.
Broken towers, huge stairs, walls with parts of them buried inside the rock and above everything else ...the golden and black crown.
It was still floating like a small star at the highest part of the mountain.
But there was no bridge or path between the island and the mountain.
The only way was that Gate.
When Lian’s group reached the central field, no one else was there yet.
They stood in front of the three Seal platforms.
"I think we arrived first." Rindo looked around.
"I think more accurately, we arrived at the same time." Seraphina said calmly and it was clear that she had sensed something.
A sound came from one of the bridges behind them, the sound of many footsteps.
Everyone turned to see what was happening and saw a few people appear first, then ten ...twenty...thirty and the number continued to grow.
Rodrick’s group entered the field from the end of the bridge, although there was no longer any sign of that army of more than seventy people.
Some had been eliminated in the Guardian battles and some were still on the way but there were still more than forty people with him, practically several times more than their group.
Rodrick was walking in front, with a Seal shining in his hand.
Strength Seal.
A little behind him and to his right, Elena was walking and had the Mana Seal.
So all five Seals now had holders.
The two groups stopped on opposite sides of the field, no one attacked and no one even spoke, but the air became noticeably heavier.
Rodrick’s eyes first fell on Rindo, then on the Resistance Seal and then slowly moved toward Lian.
The two Seals were not in his hands, but the public notifications had already made it clear who had obtained them.
Rodrick’s face remained cold and no extra emotion could be seen except for one long and calculating look.
The young Vorhelm also looked directly at him, several moments passed and then the corner of his lips rose slightly.
"It’s been a while since we’ve seen each other." He said calmly.
Rodrick looked at him for several seconds.
"It should be around ten months, right? Of course, it seems less time has passed for you, but it’s clear that you’ve changed as much as ten months."
"Long enough." Lian answered, another gaze was also still on him.
Elena.
The girl’s eyes first stayed on his face.
Then they moved down to the World-Devourer Bastion.
Then to his hands and the two Seals that she knew he had taken by himself and a complicated feeling passed through the depths of her eyes.
Shock?
Regret?
Sadness?
Maybe something else.
None of them were clear enough to give them a name, perhaps even she did not know exactly what she was feeling.
Lian kept his eyes on her for a moment, only a moment and then looked away without any special reaction.
Something in Elena’s expression became tense for a fraction of a second, but she controlled it immediately.
The young Vorhelm was now looking at someone else.
Darren.
He was standing in the second row beside Rodrick and from the moment they entered the field, he had deliberately tried not to look at him even once.
Unfortunately for him, Lian had not forgotten and his smile became a little deeper.
"Oh, good that you came too, it’s time to do your bet." He then said in a friendly tone.
