chapters.title: Chapter 449: Battle For The Crown I ( PS Bonus - )
paragraphs: Rindo also stood up and Seraphina pulled her sword out of its sheath.
Selina also walked with them and Liana raised her hand and the Silver-Crowned Griffin flew around in the sky.
Ethan, Marcus and Cassian were also ready.
"I’ll go straight for Rodrick, hold back the rest of his people." But Lian looked at them before moving.
Then lightning wrapped around his legs.
[Thunder Step]
Boom!
The stone under his feet exploded and his body shot toward the mountain path.
His arrival quickly caught the attention of Rodrick’s people and four students separated from the second line to fight him.
One was Level 29, one 31, another 32 and the strongest was 34, they stood directly in the middle of the bridge.
The Level 34 student held a heavy shield in his hand and stepped forward first.
"Vorhelm! It ends here!" he shouted and held his shield in front of his body.
Lian did not even slow down, the man lowered his shield and activated his defensive skill.
A golden layer formed on the surface of the shield.
But young Vorhelm pulled his right fist back, he did not activate any big skill and only used his physical strength.
Boom!
His fist hit the center of the shield and the sound of the impact was like a heavy cart crashing into a wall.
The golden layer broke immediately and the shield bent inward, the student’s body left the ground and was thrown ten meters back.
His Protective Seal activated before he hit the stone and he was eliminated.
The other three froze for a fraction of a second, this was not the result they had expected, at least not this quickly.
Lian passed through the place where the man had been standing and the second person attacked from the left.
His blade came close to Lian’s neck but he only moved his head a few centimeters and the sword passed beside his head.
His elbow came up.
Clack!
It hit the center of the attacker’s chest directly and his Protective Seal immediately lit up.
The second elimination happened as well.
The two remaining people attacked at the same time.
"Damn it, together!"
One from the front and one from the right, but Lian disappeared from their sight.
[Thunder Step]
Krrrack!
Lightning exploded between them and he appeared beside the person on the right, the shoulder of the World-Devourer Bastion hit the man’s body directly.
Boom!
The student was thrown several meters into the air like a broken doll, his Protective Seal activated and the third elimination happened as well.
The last person did not even have time to move back and when he turned around, young Vorhelm’s fist was in front of his face.
[Thunder Calamity]
Blue and purple light wrapped around the armor plates.
"Wait—"
Boom!
His Protective Seal activated before he could finish the sentence.
Four people had been eliminated in less than ten seconds and Lian had not stopped even once.
The people from Rodrick’s group who had seen this scene from higher up stayed silent for a few moments, some of them had only heard before that this boy was Level 23.
But what kind of Level 23 was this? This looked like at least Level 37! Where had this monster come from?
Now for the first time they understood how meaningless this number could be, against geniuses, Level could become meaningless.
"Stop him!" someone shouted.
Seven more people started moving but Lian did not even look at them and only said calmly.
"Rindo."
"Got it." The voice of the Student Council President came from behind.
Boom!
Kain passed one of the attackers and punched him hard in the face.
Seraphina entered from the other side and Selina, Ethan, Marcus and Cassian also arrived behind them.
In a few seconds, the path behind Lian turned into another battlefield.
"Go! We got these guys! Go kick that bastard’s ass! Don’t forget to get my revenge too!" Kain shouted.
Young Vorhelm continued along his path, only one person was left between him and Rodrick.
Elena saw him.
From the moment the first four people were eliminated in less than ten seconds, her eyes had not left Lian.
More people wanted to move forward, but Rindo’s group stopped them, so the path was almost open.
The girl lowered her hand, the mana strands around her disappeared, she took one step forward and then jumped down from the eastern platform.
She landed on the stairs above her former fiancé.
Clack!
Young Vorhelm slowed down a little, just enough to leave a few meters of distance between them.
Elena looked directly at him, her breathing was a little heavy and there was a small wound on her cheek, but she still had enough mana for thin lines of light to form around her fingers again.
"Stop right here." She said calmly.

Lian looked at her for a few seconds, there was no anger from the past in his eyes, nor regret, in fact there was nothing but calmness in his eyes, as if they were from two different worlds and had nothing to do with each other.
Elena saw this calmness and for a reason she herself did not want to understand, it hurt her more than any insult.
"Lian...you don’t have to do this—"
A footstep behind Lian cut her off, Seraphina passed beside him with her sword in her right hand.
Her hair moved with the mountain wind and her eyes were fixed directly on her.
"She is mine." And she said without even looking at him.
"This is between me and him, don’t interfere." Elena’s eyebrows came together slightly.
"What do you mean this is between you and him? Your relationship is over!... You already made your choice, did you forget? There is nothing left between you! This is only the final-term test now!
A few seconds of silence formed between the two girls and the mana around Elena became stronger.
"What? Are you upset? Your turn is over, so just do your job." Seraphina took another step forward.
"Move." Elena gave Lian a short look and then looked at her again.
"No."
Just one word, but it was so cold and firm that it left no room for anything else to be said.
Young Vorhelm looked at them for a few moments and then passed by his childhood friend.
"Don’t take too long." He said while going up the stairs and the corner of the girl’s lips rose very slightly.
"You too."
Elena wanted to move.
Slash!
Seraphina’s blade blocked her path and mana sparks spread between them.
Lian did not look behind him again.
He reached the last step and put his foot on the upper platform, the wind was stronger at this height.
Black clouds moved hundreds of meters below and all the islands looked much smaller from here.
Rodrick was standing on the other side of the platform.
Alone.
There was no human wall between the two of them, the Crown was in his left hand and its red light still reached into the sky.
His armor was torn in several places and dried blood could be seen on his eyebrow.
His left forearm was injured and his breathing was no longer completely calm, his mana was also clearly lower than it had been at the beginning of the battle.
But he stood straight, his shoulders back, his chin raised and the same proud look he always had.
He was neither broken nor afraid and when young Vorhelm stepped onto the platform, Rodrick slowly turned his head toward him.
Neither of them spoke for a few seconds and the sounds of the battles below the mountain could be heard from far away and unclear.
"You finally came, I thought you quit the test yourself because you were afraid to face me." The young Ashen’s voice was more tired than before, but it was still calm and confident.
"I wasn’t in a hurry, maybe I would hurry to kill a cockroach, but nobody is in a hurry to kill an ant." Lian took another step forward.
Rodrick gave the timer a short look.

"An ant? ... Pfft, haha, this was your mistake, you think because you were lucky enough to become an Awakener, you have surpassed me? This is a dream you will take to your grave, I am the King and I will remain the King!" He laughed loudly and then said

"These days they look at you with fear, but are you anything more than a coward? You waited for the rest of my people to become tired and came up when you thought it was the best time, do you know what I call this? The behavior of a coward!" Disgust filled his voice.

"But you know, at least you know when to use your brain, you know you can’t defeat me at my peak, so you wanted to fight my weakened version...but this is your second mistake, even in my weakest state I will defeat you."

"I don’t call it fear, I call it strategy, besides, aren’t you ashamed that a Level 23 Awakener has become a threat to you at all? You’re only one step away from your Second Evolution." Lian laughed and pointed out an obvious fact.
Rodrick frowned, because the words were not wrong, the fact that a Level 23 was considered a threat to him was already ridiculous.
"Anyway, enough nonsense, I didn’t come for the Crown, Rodrick, I came to see if when there is no army between us, you can still call yourself the King or not." Young Vorhelm finally added.

sentences.text: Rindo also stood up and Seraphina pulled her sword out of its sheath.
Selina also walked with them and Liana raised her hand and the Silver-Crowned Griffin flew around in the sky.
Ethan, Marcus and Cassian were also ready.
"I’ll go straight for Rodrick, hold back the rest of his people." But Lian looked at them before moving.
Then lightning wrapped around his legs.
[Thunder Step]
Boom!
The stone under his feet exploded and his body shot toward the mountain path.
His arrival quickly caught the attention of Rodrick’s people and four students separated from the second line to fight him.
One was Level 29, one 31, another 32 and the strongest was 34, they stood directly in the middle of the bridge.
The Level 34 student held a heavy shield in his hand and stepped forward first.
"Vorhelm!
It ends here!" he shouted and held his shield in front of his body.
Lian did not even slow down, the man lowered his shield and activated his defensive skill.
A golden layer formed on the surface of the shield.
But young Vorhelm pulled his right fist back, he did not activate any big skill and only used his physical strength.
Boom!
His fist hit the center of the shield and the sound of the impact was like a heavy cart crashing into a wall.
The golden layer broke immediately and the shield bent inward, the student’s body left the ground and was thrown ten meters back.
His Protective Seal activated before he hit the stone and he was eliminated.
The other three froze for a fraction of a second, this was not the result they had expected, at least not this quickly.
Lian passed through the place where the man had been standing and the second person attacked from the left.
His blade came close to Lian’s neck but he only moved his head a few centimeters and the sword passed beside his head.
His elbow came up.
Clack!
It hit the center of the attacker’s chest directly and his Protective Seal immediately lit up.
The second elimination happened as well.
The two remaining people attacked at the same time.
"Damn it, together!"
One from the front and one from the right, but Lian disappeared from their sight.
[Thunder Step]
Krrrack!
Lightning exploded between them and he appeared beside the person on the right, the shoulder of the World-Devourer Bastion hit the man’s body directly.
Boom!
The student was thrown several meters into the air like a broken doll, his Protective Seal activated and the third elimination happened as well.
The last person did not even have time to move back and when he turned around, young Vorhelm’s fist was in front of his face.
[Thunder Calamity]
Blue and purple light wrapped around the armor plates.
"Wait—"
Boom!
His Protective Seal activated before he could finish the sentence.
Four people had been eliminated in less than ten seconds and Lian had not stopped even once.
The people from Rodrick’s group who had seen this scene from higher up stayed silent for a few moments, some of them had only heard before that this boy was Level 23.
But what kind of Level 23 was this?
This looked like at least Level 37!
Where had this monster come from?
Now for the first time they understood how meaningless this number could be, against geniuses, Level could become meaningless.
"Stop him!" someone shouted.
Seven more people started moving but Lian did not even look at them and only said calmly.
"Rindo."
"Got it." The voice of the Student Council President came from behind.
Boom!
Kain passed one of the attackers and punched him hard in the face.
Seraphina entered from the other side and Selina, Ethan, Marcus and Cassian also arrived behind them.
In a few seconds, the path behind Lian turned into another battlefield.
"Go!
We got these guys!
Go kick that bastard’s ass!
Don’t forget to get my revenge too!" Kain shouted.
Young Vorhelm continued along his path, only one person was left between him and Rodrick.
Elena saw him.
From the moment the first four people were eliminated in less than ten seconds, her eyes had not left Lian.
More people wanted to move forward, but Rindo’s group stopped them, so the path was almost open.
The girl lowered her hand, the mana strands around her disappeared, she took one step forward and then jumped down from the eastern platform.
She landed on the stairs above her former fiancé.
Clack!
Young Vorhelm slowed down a little, just enough to leave a few meters of distance between them.
Elena looked directly at him, her breathing was a little heavy and there was a small wound on her cheek, but she still had enough mana for thin lines of light to form around her fingers again.
"Stop right here." She said calmly.

Lian looked at her for a few seconds, there was no anger from the past in his eyes, nor regret, in fact there was nothing but calmness in his eyes, as if they were from two different worlds and had nothing to do with each other.
Elena saw this calmness and for a reason she herself did not want to understand, it hurt her more than any insult.
"Lian...you don’t have to do this—"
A footstep behind Lian cut her off, Seraphina passed beside him with her sword in her right hand.
Her hair moved with the mountain wind and her eyes were fixed directly on her.
"She is mine." And she said without even looking at him.
"This is between me and him, don’t interfere." Elena’s eyebrows came together slightly.
"What do you mean this is between you and him?
Your relationship is over!...
You already made your choice, did you forget?
There is nothing left between you!
This is only the final-term test now!
A few seconds of silence formed between the two girls and the mana around Elena became stronger.
"What?
Are you upset?
Your turn is over, so just do your job." Seraphina took another step forward.
"Move." Elena gave Lian a short look and then looked at her again.
"No."
Just one word, but it was so cold and firm that it left no room for anything else to be said.
Young Vorhelm looked at them for a few moments and then passed by his childhood friend.
"Don’t take too long." He said while going up the stairs and the corner of the girl’s lips rose very slightly.
"You too."
Elena wanted to move.
Slash!
Seraphina’s blade blocked her path and mana sparks spread between them.
Lian did not look behind him again.
He reached the last step and put his foot on the upper platform, the wind was stronger at this height.
Black clouds moved hundreds of meters below and all the islands looked much smaller from here.
Rodrick was standing on the other side of the platform.
Alone.

chapters.title: Chapter 450: Battle For The Crown II
paragraphs: Rodrick looked at Lian, those words echoed clearly in his mind, but he did not get angry or react to his obvious provocation.
Instead, a very small smile appeared on his tired face.
"Then there is no need to say anything more."
The Crown was still in his left hand and then he closed his right hand.
Crack!
The joints of his fingers made a sound.
And young Vorhelm looked at him, as far as he knew, this boy’s original class was also Warrior and like him, he used his fists to fight.
But he did not know what his class had evolved into after his First Evolution, or what it had changed into.
Mana began to flow through both of their bodies and it was as if they were waiting to see who would make the first move.
Boom!
And at that moment Rodrick disappeared, the speed of his first step was so high that the several-dozen-meter distance between them was cut in half in an instant.
[Tyrant’s Advance]
Mana had moved down from his spine and flowed through his legs, hips and joints, every step he took forward kept part of the momentum from the previous step and added it to the next movement.
First step.
Crack!
Second step.
Boom!
Third step and Lian’s smile disappeared, Predator’s Instincts warned him before the fist arrived.
Mountain Anchor.
World-Devourer Bastion became one with the ground in an instant and he raised both forearms and ...the fist arrived.
BOOOOOOM!
The sound of the impact spread across the entire peak like the explosion of a cannon, a wave of air passed through the platform and pieces of stone were thrown into the air across dozens of meters.
Young Vorhelm’s feet sank into the stone.
Ten centimeters.
Twenty.
And even with Mountain Anchor, his body was pulled back several centimeters across the ground and his eyes went down for a moment.
A deep mark had formed under the heels of his armor.
Rodrick pulled his fist back.
"Were you expecting less?" he asked calmly.
Lian raised his head again and his smile returned.
"No, I was hoping you would at least have this much hidden." Lightning slowly appeared between his fingers.
[Thunder Calamity]
Krrrraaaack!
Blue and purple lightning wrapped around the right forearm of his armor and his fist went directly toward Rodrick’s face.
He kept his left hand, which held the Crown, back and blocked the attack with his right forearm.
Clack!
The lightning exploded but at that moment, something strange happened, a large part of the force of the attack instead of pushing Rodrick’s body back, went into his arm and shoulder.
A golden line ran from his forearm to his chest for a fraction of a second.
[King’s Reprisal]
Lian’s eyes narrowed slightly and his enemy threw another punch, but this time the attack did not only have his own strength, part of the same force he had taken from Lian’s punch was also behind it.
Boom!
Young Vorhelm raised his hand and the attack landed on the front plate of his armor and his body moved half a step back but Rodrick gave him no time.
Elbow.
Knee.
Fist.
Three attacks came toward him almost without a gap.
His class had changed into Tyrant Sovereign after his evolution and it had also changed his entire body structure, a special class for a ruthless fighter like him.
Tyrant Body had made mana constantly strengthen the bones in his hands, elbows, shoulders, hips and knees.
Every part of his body was a weapon and unlike most warriors who lost a lot of power without a weapon, he became more dangerous at this close range.
Of course, his main power did not come from his four-star class, but from his S-Rank talent.
Lian deflected the first elbow and the second knee hit the side of his armor.
The third punch came toward him and at the same moment Predator’s Instincts warned him again.
But this time it was more than an ordinary punch, dense mana had been compressed right behind Rodrick’s knuckles.
[Crushing Decree]
Young Vorhelm raised his forearm.
Clack!
The first impact happened and Mountain Frame spread the force throughout the World-Devourer Bastion.
For a moment Lian thought it was over ... but he was very wrong.
BOOOOM!
A second explosion happened from the same point and the compressed mana that had entered the armor plate at the moment of impact exploded with a slight delay.
His body was thrown several meters back and his feet dragged across the stone.
Crack!
A thin crack appeared on the chest plate of the armor.
[Structural damage detected.]
[Structural Memory activated.]
Silver lines lit up between the armor plates and the crack slowly began to repair itself but what the armor could not completely remove was the force that had passed through it.
The taste of iron and blood spread inside his mouth, he ran his tongue over his injured lip.
"Good." Then he laughed.
Rodrick raised an eyebrow.
"Do you say that every time you get hit? Has your brain gone crazy, Lian? Does two years of being a loser affect your brain this much...oh, of course, you will always remain a loser."
"Do you know how long it has been since someone was able to make me take them seriously?" He was not lying either.
"Your brain really has gone crazy." Rodrick simply thought his words were the result of madness.
Both moved again.
[Time Remaining: 07:51.]
Their attacks exploded across the peak one after another.
Neither Rodrick was willing to move back nor Lian.
Every time the first one moved with Tyrant’s Advance, his steps became stronger and his next punch gained more power.
The second one no longer needed True Sequence after the third time to understand the basic structure.
Rodrick had to keep moving forward to reach the highest possible power, so the problem was simple, he could not let his steps be completed.
He came forward again.
First step.
Boom!
Second step—
"So you have to keep moving forward to perform this move, right?" young Vorhelm whispered.
"Do you have a problem with that?" Rodrick kept his fists raised.
"No, this makes it even better, because you are entering the range I want."
Lian put his foot on the ground.
Frost Dominion.
Cold spread under both of their feet like an invisible wave and the stone surface of the peak was covered with smooth and clear ice in the blink of an eye.
Rodrick did not care and took his second step.
But at that moment the ice under his foot changed shape and suddenly its surface became tilted by several degrees, less than what an ordinary person would even notice.
But for someone who had placed all the weight, momentum and balance of his body into one chain of movement, it was enough to ruin all his calculations.
His foot slipped a few centimeters and the chain of his advance was broken, his eyes changed for a moment.
And young Vorhelm had already moved.
[Thunder Step]
Krrrack!
He entered his defense in an instant and Thunder Calamity gathered around his left fist.
Boom!
His fist hit Rodrick’s side and the protective mana around his body exploded, he was thrown several meters to the right and stopped himself on the ground with the sole of his foot.
"Now you understand? This stupid skill of yours does not work against me, I can control the environment however I want."
Rodrick looked at the ice under his feet and then raised his head again, there was no anger on his face.
"I understand, then I just need to break everything like a tyrant." And he moved again.
Lian waited but this time, with every step he took, a short wave of mana entered the ground from the sole of his foot.
Crack!
The ice broke just before his foot touched it.
First step.
Crack!
Second step.
Crack!
Third step.
Tyrant’s Advance was completed again.
"You learn fast." Young Vorhelm clapped for him in approval, but he also expected this bastard to find a way to counter it.
That was what a battle was like, during it both sides used different strategies, ways to counter those strategies were discovered and they were forced to find new strategies again.
As long as both sides were more or less equal, this was how the situation was, Rodrick had at least 6000 stat points and defeating him was not going to be easy for him either.
"If tricking me once is enough to defeat me, then I don’t deserve this Crown." And at the same time the fist came.
Lian dodged and the pressure wave passed beside his face and shattered a large rock several meters behind him.
At that moment he understood, this man was not only strong, he was also adaptable, so the same trick could not be used on him twice.
Good, he enjoyed opponents who forced him to think more, although sometimes they could also become annoying...
A few more exchanges happened, Crushing Decree came toward Lian’s face again.
This time he did not defend, in fact he deliberately waited and the distance became smaller.
One meter.
Half a meter.
Rodrick’s fist almost reached his face guard and young Vorhelm’s body suddenly turned black.
Not only the armor but his own body as well and in an instant his human form collapsed and turned into a mass of hot ash.
Fsh!
Rodrick’s fist passed through the ash and his eyes opened wider.
"What—"
The ash gathered several meters behind him, feet ...torso...arms and Lian formed again.
[Ash Step]

This was a skill he had obtained from the Cindari in the Special Area, he had not had a good chance to use it ... at least until now and the only problem with this skill was that its maximum potential was Common Rank.
Lightning gathered in front of his right fist.
The young Ashen started turning around to block the fist ... but it was too late!
BOOOOM!
The fist covered with Thunder Calamity hit directly into the back of his shoulder, his body left the ground and hit the stone several meters ahead before rolling across the icy surface.
Rodrick put one hand on the ground and stood up, spat a few drops of blood onto the ground and part of the armor on the back of his shoulder was burned.
A little blood ran from the corner of his lips and he wiped it away with the back of his hand.
His eyes became colder than before, and there he understood that just as he still had many things he had not shown, his enemy was also hiding many trump cards...
This battle was not going to be as easy as either side had thought.
